documentedConstraints: Serialize requests; no concurrent API calls
Cache reusable results and back off on failures or throttling
No browser embedding under the stated CORS policy
Check response version because formats may change
Best-effort service with no indefinite-availability guarantee
consequence: A direct online production dependency has not passed reliability/determinism/operational admission. A separately reviewed offline-data or server-side policy would still need provenance, license/data-rights review, range, precision and independent validation.
